module: Condition editor of the Mission Editor, used twice by missionEditor.lua: "Start Condition" (field startCondition) and "Visibility Conditions" (field visibleCondition). At startup, it loads all the files of /lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/missions/unlocks/conditions/ (via FS:findFiles and require) and merges their condition tables; each condition type has a suitable ImGui display (mission, value, numeric comparison, career level, WP category, manufacturer, transmission layout, propulsion, branch, league, nested conditions). The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor, field, name).
notes: Conditions are stored in mission[field] as {type = '...', ...}; nested conditions are in condition.nested ("Add" button adds {type = 'always'}).
The progressKey field of a progress condition accepts 'any' (any key) and 'default' (default key).
Bug: getMissionIssues first tests whether mission[field] is nil, but does not stop the function; the next line then reads .type on nil and causes an error.
The draw state (index, depth) is global to the module, shared by all instances; it is reset in draw.
The available conditions depend on the files present in the unlocks/conditions folder; duplicate keys are overwritten by the last file read.

C.desc: Sub-window for editing a mission condition.

init.desc: Constructor: remembers missionEditor, the edited field and the displayed label, then loads all the available conditions from gameplay/missions/unlocks/conditions/.

field.desc: Name of the mission field (for example 'startCondition' or 'visibleCondition').

name.desc: Label displayed in the left column.

setMission.desc: Selects the mission to edit and clears the input fields cache.

getMissionIssues.desc: Calls setMission then returns the issues: no condition defined (error), or condition set to "never" (error).

draw.desc: Draws the mission's condition (default {type='always'}) with its label, recursively for nested conditions.
